test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A alone can complete a work in 40 days. 20 percent of the same work will be completed by A in how many days?
solution:
**Given: **

A completes work in 40 days.

**Concept Used:**

Work = Rate × Time

**Calculation:**

A's rate is 1/40 of the work per day.

Time for 20% of work is: Time = 0.20 / (1/40) = 8 days.

So, A takes 8 days to complete 20% of the work.

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
